name: War: 13th Day
source:
How has the sun disappeared from Virgo Island?

Hear the story from an elegant lady or a sassy warrioress. Each has their own version of the events that led to the sun’s disappearance.

Decide whether their tale ends in romance, heartbreak, or even murder.

[From [url=http://askdreamgazer.tumblr.com/post/137585051702/war-13th-day-on-itchio-and-gamejolt]Tumblr site[/url]]
translation:
太阳是怎么从处女岛消失的？

聆听优雅女士或时髦女战士讲述的故事。对于导致太阳消失的事件，每个人都有自己的版本。

决定他们的故事是否以浪漫、心碎甚至谋杀结束。

[来自[url=http://askdreamgazer.tumblr.com/post/137585051702/war-13th-day-on-itchio-and-gamejolt]Tumblr网站[/url]]
